request.questionText: A data scientist fits a groupwise linear model to predict Revenue from research grants in terms of affiliation of the research team with 1 of 8 academic Institutions in the University of Texas system: UT Arlington UT Austin UT Dallas UT El Paso UT Permian Basin UT Rio Grande Valley UT San Antonio UT Tyler If this model has a "baseline/offset" form, how many dummy variables would it use to encode the variable for academic Institution?
